findings.passage: For like 15 or 20 minutes, I led him through every single aspect of this, and he could not give a good reason why they were doing it. And so that makes it harder to vote.
findings.note: Said at the LWV candidate forum (transcript from On the Record). He is describing a state law that ended the use of a student ID as a voter ID, and says he questioned the bill's author about it. Text taken from the extracted transcript file, since the OTR page loads by script.

findings.passage: One of the saddest things that I see, and it happens every election cycle, if you go to the county election board when they meet about 10 days after the election, they go through their provisional ballots.
findings.note: Same forum answer. He describes provisional ballots cast by students who were not registered, and says education about registration deadlines and precincts is needed. Related to what happens when a voter's ballot does not count.
